subject: LaunchPad cohort credits — request for promotional top-up
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya@launchpad.co>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: LaunchPad cohort credits top-up

Hi Camila,

Hope you’re well — I run the LaunchPad Collective accelerator (we bring ~30 early-stage teams through an 8-week sprint). We partnered with Redwood last year and the startups used the standard seed credits; this cohort is ~50% larger and several teams are running heavier inference workloads for demos coming up.

Would Redwood consider a one-time promotional top-up for the LaunchPad cohort beyond the standard startup bundle? Specifically, we’re asking for an additional $30k of credits to be distributed across the cohort (non-transferable, for usage in the next 90 days). This would be highlighted in our partner materials and we can share a short quote and case study.

I’ve attached the cohort roster and a short program note. Happy to jump on a quick call if it helps. We’d like to finalize by next week so teams can plan their demos.

Thanks —
Maya Patel
Program Director, LaunchPad Collective
maya@launchpad.co
+1 415-555-0108

Attachments: launchpad-cohort-roster.csv (csv stub)

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@launchpad.co>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-18T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: LaunchPad cohort credits top-up

Hi Maya — thanks for the note and the roster. Great to hear the cohort is expanding.

Short answer: we can consider a one-time promo top-up but I’ll need approval from sales ops and finance for the amount and terms. Quick proposal from our side: 1) $30k one-time promo credit pool, 2) credits distributed to cohort startups by LaunchPad admin (non-transferable), 3) 90-day expiration, 4) case study + short quote in exchange.

Next steps: I’ll route this internally for approval and come back with a formal offer (and a short cohort agreement for signatures). Can you confirm the billing contact for invoicing (if needed) and whether LaunchPad requires an explicit invoice/PO to accept credits?

I’m copying Marissa from finance to keep billing in the loop.

—
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Partnerships, Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com

Attachments: credits_policy.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-18T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: LaunchPad cohort credits top-up — approval request

Forwarding LaunchPad’s request — they want a $30k cohort top-up (non-transferable, 90-day use window) in exchange for PR/case study. Roster attached.

Why I’m asking: high distribution opportunity (50+ startups), strong signal for more accelerator partnerships. Short-term revenue impact minimal but strategic value high. Recommend approving $30k as a promo credit with the following constraints:
- Credits expire 90 days from issuance
- Credits non-transferable and limited to inference usage (text generation/embeddings)
- LaunchPad to provide a signed cohort agreement and a short quote/case study within 60 days
- Finance to confirm there is no cash refund option and add a note to the account profile

Aditya — I recall we had a promo buffer for these partner plays. Can you weigh in on authority level for sign-off? Marissa — please confirm billing constraints and whether we should require a nominal invoice/PO.

Subject: Re: Fwd: LaunchPad cohort credits top-up — approval request

Camila — I approve a $30k promotional credit pool for LaunchPad under the constraints you listed. Two conditions to operationalize:
1) Add a short data/retention note requiring LaunchPad to agree that cohort usage may be surfaced in aggregate logs for quality monitoring (no PII), and
2) Promo must be applied from a partner promo bucket — confirm expiry mechanics with billing.

Marissa — please set up the account pool and confirm there’s no AR impact (i.e., this is purely promotional credit issuance). If finance flags anything, revert. I’m comfortable with the PR ask; getting 50+ dev teams using Redwood in demos is worth it.

Aditya
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Confirmed — will create a partner promo credit pool for Deal LP-202607-03, set 90-day expiration, and mark credits as non-transferable. I’ll also generate a short invoice stub for LaunchPad’s procurement records (no cash collection required). Need LaunchPad’s PO or procurement email to attach.

Marissa Cole
Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Maya Patel <maya@launchpad.co>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@launchpad.co
Date: 2026-07-19T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: LaunchPad cohort credits top-up

Camila — fantastic, thank you and please thank Aditya and Marissa for the quick turnaround. LaunchPad accepts the terms. We will: 1) sign the cohort agreement, 2) provide a short quote for a case study, and 3) route a PO to procurement@launchpad.co for your invoice stub.

Please send the cohort agreement and the invoice stub and we’ll return the signed copy today. Start date for cohort demos is Aug 2, so the 90-day window works for us.

Appreciate the partnership — looking forward to working together again.

Best,
Maya
Program Director, LaunchPad Collective
